title: Find the display name of the oldest user from New York who has earned both
question: Find the display name of the oldest user from New York who has earned both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges, and who has posted at least one comment with a score between 1 and 5.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'New York'
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT "XCL_002" FROM badges WHERE "XCL_003" = 'Teacher')
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT "XCL_002" FROM badges WHERE "XCL_003" = 'Supporter')
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (SELECT "XCL_010" FROM comments WHERE "XCL_007" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
ORDER BY T1."XCL_054" ASC
LIMIT 1
